Following up from last week's demo: attached is an updated MAP (acme-map-v2.xlsx) and the evaluation plan (poc-eval-plan.pdf). This note is the standing weekly checkpoint for the POC so we have a single source of truth on milestones, acceptance criteria, and blockers.

Current snapshot:
- Trial window: 2 weeks (Mar 9 — Mar 23) — provisional based on data availability
- Primary acceptance criteria (high level):

  2) Semantic recall: F1 >= 0.78 on the evaluation set you shared
  3) Stable throughput: sustained 100 qps for 30m with no errors >1%

Attached materials include the evaluation test cases and the acceptance checklist. Can you confirm the criteria above match what you need for the internal signoff? Also, please call out any missing tests or an additional metric you want tracked.

Proposed meeting: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Tue Mar 9, 10:00am PT (30m). If that works I will send a calendar invite and a short agenda (status, blockers, actions/owners).

- Eval harness run & baseline report (owner: Connor O'Brien) — first run by Mar 10

Attachments: acme-map-v2.xlsx, poc-eval-plan.pdf, data-access-checklist.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
